facts: About 124 million people (2024), the world's 11th most populous
Four major islands and over 14,000 smaller ones
worth_knowing: Sometimes called the Land of the Rising Sun. About 75% of its terrain is mountainous and heavily forested, so most people live on the eastern coastal plains.
